verdict: Meta is delivering; Google spend produced zero leads and is being fixed.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 152 leads at an average cost of $15.94 per lead — all of them from Meta, where efficiency improved sharply this past week with leads up 44% and cost per lead down 21% versus the prior week. Google Ads ran $813 in spend over the same 28-day window and produced zero conversions; conversion tracking is being repaired and Google spend has been pulled back while that fix is completed. On the pipeline side, 131 new opportunities were created in your CRM this period, but none have moved to a booked appointment yet — that intake gap is being reviewed separately from ad performance. Next period, expect dedicated landing pages and a new creative batch to go live, which should support continued Meta efficiency and give Google a cleaner foundation once tracking is restored.

drop in cost per lead on Meta in the most recent 7 days versus the prior 7

watch_item.issue: Google Ads has spent $813 over 28 days and returned zero conversions — confirmed tracking is broken.
watch_item.fix: Conversion tracking is being rebuilt and spend has been reduced in the meantime; offline conversion import is scheduled to go live by end of September to give Google reliable signal going forward.
